stories.title: Define PI credibility UI data contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data schema for PI credibility display including investigator name, institution, prior trial count, publication indicator, and score contribution. Ensure compatibility with backend feature EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI and MessageBubble rendering pipeline.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx rendering pipeline; backend dependency EVAL-CT-MEASURE-PI provides PI metrics.

stories.title: Implement PI credibility rendering logic
stories.description: Build frontend logic to transform PI credibility data into display-ready format including conditional rendering for missing fields, formatting trial counts, and computing visual score contribution indicators.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx supports structured markdown rendering; GAP: no existing PI-specific transformation logic.

stories.title: Integrate PI credibility into trial scorecard UI
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble or introduce a reusable component to display PI credibility within the clinical trial scorecard, including layout, labeling, and visual hierarchy aligned with existing chat UI patterns.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx is current rendering surface; GAP: no PI display component exists.

stories.title: Add API binding and error handling for PI data
stories.description: Bind frontend UI to backend PI credibility data payload, including handling null/partial responses, fallback messaging, and safe rendering when PI data is unavailable.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/facades/evaluate_care_facade.py orchestrates clinical trial responses; GAP: no PI-specific API contract currently exposed.

stories.title: Test PI credibility display and edge cases
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating PI credibility rendering, including missing data scenarios, formatting correctness, and consistency with score contribution display.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend has existing test structure; GAP: no tests for PI display component.
